definitions.explanation: Explanatory notes or comments added to a text to clarify its meaning.

examples.japanese: {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{括弧|かっこ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{本|ほん}→本：00111_hon⟧⟦には→には：00314_ni⟧{詳|くわ}しい{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{付|つ}いている。
{難|むずか}しい{言葉|ことば}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{注釈|ちゅうしゃく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{付|つ}ける。
examples.english: To add annotations to difficult words.

notes:
{注釈|ちゅうしゃく} refers to explanatory notes or comments added to a text to help the reader understand difficult words, historical context, or technical terms.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}を{付|つ}ける: to add annotations
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}を{入|い}れる: to insert notes
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}{付|つ}き: annotated, with notes
- {注釈|ちゅうしゃく}{書|しょ}: annotated edition, commentary

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {解説|かいせつ}: explanation, commentary (more detailed and interpretive)
- {脚注|きゃくちゅう}: footnote (specifically at the bottom of a page)
- {注|ちゅう}: note (shorter form, often used in academic writing)
- {補足|ほそく}: supplement, additional explanation
